data.name: Sushil
data.gender_notes: Sushil is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sushil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'su' meaning good and 'shil' meaning rock or mountain. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Vishnu, who is known for his calm and peaceful demeanor. The name signifies a strong, unwavering spirit, capable of overcoming any obstacle with grace and composure.
data.etymology: Sushil belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Calm, Peaceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sushil total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
